direction: Read this short film dialogue. N: a dog, bright and quick, warm, never hushed or breathy. Sam: an old man, gravelly, slow and gentle.
lines: I've tried to leave this man thirty-seven times.
Every time I get twelve blocks away... I'm standing right next to him.
I've tried at night. Through the wheat. I even swam for it.
He feeds me raw porkchops. Never cooked. Not once.
And when he says sit... I sit. I don't know why.
Everyone in this village is so tall.
And there's this dog. Wherever I go... it's already there.

lines: I can't even open a door.
When he leaves, I wait by the door. all day.
skeletons run when they see me.
Then one night, a zombie came for him.
I don't remember what happened next.
